recipe.name: Caramel Mousse & Peach Tart
directions:
For the tart crust:

Work butter with the powdered sugar. Then add the grated rind of 1 lemon, half of the egg yolks, the flour, and a pinch of salt. Knead the dough briefly until homogenous. Cover in plastic wrap and let rest in the fridge for 1 hour. Roll out the tart crust dough to a thickness of about 3 mm. Use it to line 2 tart molds. Trim the edge, pierce the bottom and cover with baking parchment. Then fill with dried beans or pie weights and blind bake the crusts for about 25 minutes at 340°F (170°C). Remove the beans and baking parchment and let cook for another 5 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool.
